outcome_source_auth.message: The source sign-in expired or access was denied. Sign in directly on the source platform, then have this result reviewed before another transfer.

outcome_receipt_invalid.message: TGP did not return a valid transfer receipt. The affected batch needs reconciliation, not a blind retry.

outcome_settlement_failed.message: The final status could not be confirmed. Earlier transfer receipts are retained below.

outcome_source_incomplete.message: Some source pages could not be read. Their record counts are unknown.

outcome_interrupted_detail.message: The transfer stopped before every result could be confirmed. Preserve this summary for review.

outcome_receipt.message: $RECEIVED$ confirmed received: $INSERTED$ newly staged, $DEDUPED$ with no new row.

outcome_unconfirmed.message: $COUNT$ unconfirmed. They may already have reached TGP; do not retry blindly.

outcome_coverage.message: Missing-record count is unknown. Unread pages or unsupported data may contain more records.

outcome_native.message: These are transfer receipts, not verified clients or history ready to use in TGP.

outcome_no_receipt.message: No detailed transfer receipts are available. This does not prove that nothing was written.

outcome_guidance.message: Keep this result. Copy the summary for TGP support before another transfer. Automatic recovery is not available yet.

outcome_running_guidance.message: Check status to see the latest recorded progress. A new transfer is blocked here to protect this result.

outcome_summary_heading.message: TGP importer: local transfer summary (not verified migration)

outcome_loading.message: Checking previous transfer. Start is paused until status is known. You can check status again if this takes too long.

outcome_status_unavailable.message: Could not confirm whether a previous transfer exists. Start remains paused. Use Check status to try again without starting a transfer.

outcome_ready.message: No recorded transfer. Open your source platform to start.

outcome_checked.message: Local status checked. This does not verify server recovery.

outcome_check_failed.message: Could not check status. Your last displayed result is unchanged.

outcome_copied.message: Summary copied. No client details or credentials included.

outcome_copy_failed.message: Could not copy. You can select and copy the visible result instead.

start_import_unconfirmed.message: Start was not confirmed. Check the importer status before trying again.
start_import_unconfirmed.description: A lost or unsuccessful Start reply does not prove that no work ran.

replay_staging_counts.message: $RECEIVED$ received: $INSERTED$ new staged, $DEDUPED$ no new row
replay_staging_counts.description: Backend staging acknowledgements, not verified native records; no-new-row does not prove correct deduplication.

replay_notify_staged.message: Records from $PLATFORM$ were staged in TGP. Migration is not verified. Review the importer status.
replay_notify_staged.description: Successful receipt is not proof of native records or complete business migration.

replay_status_staged.message: Transfer staged. Migration is not verified.
replay_status_staged.description: Label for legacy ingest_succeeded state; never imply native migration completion.

replay_partial_skipped.description: Partial import reason: malformed responses or exhausted request retries.

replay_partial_budget.description: Partial import reason: additional work exceeds a configured safety budget.

replay_partial_pagination_cycle.description: Partial import reason: a page URL was repeated before exhaustion was proved.

replay_partial_page_ceiling.message: pagination reached the safe page-number ceiling
replay_partial_page_ceiling.description: Partial import reason: the next page number would exceed the safe integer range.

replay_partial_incomplete.description: Fallback reason when no recognized partial-import category is present.

replay_partial_summary.message: partial import ($REASONS$) — $COUNT$ record(s) received. Migration is not complete. Contact TGP support with this warning before retrying.
replay_partial_summary.description: Bounded warning and recovery guidance; receiving records does not mean native migration is complete.

prestart_session_changed.message: Your TGP session changed before this import could start. Sign in again, then start the import.
prestart_session_changed.description: No-run error: the coach's TGP session was replaced before Start ran. Fact then remedy; no worker-internal detail.

prestart_pairing_needed.message: TGP needs you to sign in again before this import can start. Sign in, then start the import.
prestart_pairing_needed.description: No-run error: pairing or sign-in is required before Start can proceed. Fact then remedy.

prestart_page_unsupported.message: This page can't be imported from. Open a supported page on your source platform, then start the import.
prestart_page_unsupported.description: No-run error: the active tab's site is not one the importer supports. No vendor or platform name is shown.

prestart_unsafe_origin.message: This page isn't a safe place to start an import from. Open the source platform directly, then start the import.
prestart_unsafe_origin.description: No-run error: the active tab's origin failed the import-safety allowlist check.

prestart_no_reader.message: TGP doesn't yet have a reader for this site. No records were read or sent.
prestart_no_reader.description: No-run error: no extractor exists for the detected platform. The platform/vendor slug is never shown (X6).

prestart_site_setup_unavailable.message: Setup for this site isn't available right now. No records were read or sent. Try again shortly.
prestart_site_setup_unavailable.description: No-run error: the platform's blueprint could not be resolved (missing or failed to load).

prestart_unknown.message: The import could not start. No records were read or sent. Try again, and contact TGP support if this continues.
prestart_unknown.description: No-run error: generic fallback for any lastError not in the approved catalog. Never shows raw worker text.

server_status_heading.description: Heading for what the TGP server itself has recorded for this run, kept separate from this browser's local receipts.

server_status_note.message: What TGP itself has recorded for this transfer, shown separately from this browser's receipts above.

server_status_not_yet_known.message: Not yet known. TGP has no record of this transfer to show yet. This does not mean nothing was sent.
server_status_not_yet_known.description: The status read answered 404, which the backend uses uniformly for no evidence yet, a foreign run or a dark route. Never shown as 0.

server_status_unavailable.message: Could not check TGP. The receipts above are unchanged.
server_status_unavailable.description: Any network, auth, rate-limit or shape fault on the status read. No server state is guessed.

server_status_open.message: No final state recorded on TGP yet.
server_status_open.description: Server status is running. No percent, phase or ETA is shown.

server_status_final.description: The server's settled terminal is the final state of this run.

state.example: partial; some records may be missing

server_state_success.message: transfer settled; records staged, migration not verified
server_state_success.description: Legacy server terminal success is a transport settlement, not a verified native migration.

server_state_partial.message: partial; some records may be missing

server_family_committed.description: Server-committed count for one family. Never summed across families.

server_family_unknown.message: Committed on TGP: not yet known
server_family_unknown.description: A family this browser has receipts for that the server response does not list. Never shown as 0.
